column2: [intro]
In my mind, it's all in bright hues
Memories are neatly in their cues
I recall each face with such ease
Like it was yesterday, it’s a breeze
I have a visual memory
My brain’s a machine, it’s clear to see
I see it all, I recall it too
It's my superpower, it’s true!
I'm the Sherlock Holmes of daily life
Details never pass me by, no strife
I remember phone numbers with grace
Even after a single brief exchange
The hawk-eyed trait is my guide
I spot every clue that may hide
On photos, I zoom and scan
Nothing escapes me, I’m the keenest man
[ solo ]
I’ve got the memory of an elephant
But sometimes it’s quite apparent
I remember every little thing
Even those that seem mundane and bring
[outro]
